title: Introduce transductive anchor prober and CI gating for prompt-set consistency
author: Maya Patel
description:
Motivation: flakiness in prompt-set regression checks arises when cohort-level summary statistics miss localized instabilities tied to input distribution shift. This PR introduces a transductive anchored prober: an anchor-driven sampling strategy that builds a small, per-prompt neighborhood using model-inferred similarity at evaluation time and runs focused consistency checks. The prober is designed to detect regressions that only surface under model-side distribution drift and to produce a compact signal that can be gated in CI.

What this PR does (single continuous description): - Adds a transductive anchor sampler and probing harness that constructs neighborhood examples around human-curated anchors and computes consistency metrics (agreement, rank-stability, and entropy-delta) for each prompt. - Integrates a lightweight CI hook (ci/hooks/anchor_gate.py) that runs the prober in parallel with existing smoke-evals and can fail the build when per-anchor inconsistency exceeds a configurable threshold. - Wires the gate into ci/workflows/eval-gates.yml behind a feature flag (EVAL_ANCHOR_GATE) so we can opt-in per-branch. - Adds instrumentation: per-anchor telemetry (latency, consistency_score, sample_size) and an example dashboard config. - Includes unit and integration tests, a small example notebook for debugging anchors, and docs describing best practices and threshold selection.

Checklist: - [x] Implementation of transductive anchor prober and sampler - [x] Unit tests covering edge cases (empty anchors, tiny neighborhoods) - [x] CI hook + workflow integration behind flag - [x] Docs and example notebook - [x] Alertable metric emitted to eval-metrics namespace for downstream dashboards

Rollout plan: Enable EVAL_ANCHOR_GATE=false for main for one week while we backfill historical runs using scripts/anchor-backfill.sh and inspect signal quality. On successful calibration, flip the flag for release branches and enable soft-fail mode (metric-only) before hard-failing CI. Related Linear: ENG-4621.

Notes: Thresholds default to conservative values (consistency_score < 0.85 triggers soft-fail). Config lives in eval-harness/config/anchor_gate.yaml (see docs).

release_notes: Adds a transductive anchor prober and a CI gate that detects localized prompt-set regressions caused by model distribution drift. Includes instrumentation, an opt-in feature flag, docs, tests, and a backfill script for historical calibration. Default behavior is metric-only (soft-fail) with conservative thresholds; operators can opt into hard-fail after calibration.
